- Add `pr-check-comment.yml`: on `workflow_run` of `Lint` and `PR Title`, post one PR comment listing the failed checks once both have finished for the PR head. It runs main's code and reads only API metadata, so fork PRs get comments without running PR code.
- A new comment is posted only when a failed run has not been reported yet; older comments are minimized as outdated, and all of them once every check passes. Draft PRs are skipped.
- The PR title error is quoted from its `pull_request_target` run; lint gets a run link and a fixed `pre-commit` hint, since a PR controls its own lint output.

detail.title: [CI] pr-check-comment: Comment on PRs when lint or title check fails

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+name: PR Check Comment
+# Comments on a PR when its lint or PR title check fails. Uses workflow_run
+# because a fork PR's pull_request run only gets a read-only token. Safe: this
+# runs main's code and reads only API metadata, never PR code or artifacts.
+
+on:
+  workflow_run:
+    workflows: ["Lint", "PR Title"]
+    types: [completed]
+
+permissions:
+  actions: read
+  checks: read
+  contents: read
+  issues: write
+  pull-requests: write
+
+concurrency:
+  # Serialize per commit so the two checks finishing together post one comment.
+  group: pr-check-comment-${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  comment:
+    if: github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' || github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request_target'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          sparse-checkout: .github/scripts
+
+      - name: Comment on failed checks
+        uses: actions/github-script@v8
+        with:
+          script: |
+            const { run } = require(
+              `${process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.github/scripts/pr-check-comment.cjs`
+            );
+            await run({ github, context, core });
